children.value: How long does 100ml of vape liquid last?

Mixed with two nic shots, Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid becomes 120ml, which lasts a light sub-ohm vaper on 3ml a day around 40 days, an average user on 6ml a day about 20 days, and a heavy user on 10ml a day roughly 12 days. Coils under 0.2 ohm use liquid fastest.
How many puffs is 100ml of e-liquid?

There is no fixed puff figure for a shortfill because sub-ohm draws vary, but a 120ml mixed bottle of Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid at 10 to 15 puffs per ml gives between 1,200 and 1,800 direct-to-lung puffs. Lower wattage and shorter draws push the number up.
How much nicotine is in 100ml shortfill?

None as supplied. Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid is 0mg in the bottle, which is what allows a 100ml size under UK rules. Nicotine only enters when you add shots: two 10ml 18mg shots give 120ml at 3mg, and one shot gives 110ml at about 1.6mg.
Can you buy nic salts in 100ml?

Not with nicotine already in them. UK law limits nicotine-containing e-liquid to 10ml bottles, so a 100ml bottle is always a 0mg shortfill like Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid. You can add 20mg nic salt shots instead of 18mg freebase shots for a smoother throat hit at 3mg.
How do I add a nic shot to the Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid shortfill?

Press and twist off the childproof cap, pull out the nozzle insert, squeeze a full 10ml nic shot into the bottle, add a second for 3mg, refit the nozzle and cap, then shake for a minute and leave overnight.
Can you use a shortfill without nicotine?
Yes. Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid is made to be vaped at 0mg if you add no shots, and the flavour is complete without them. Choose the 0mg option in the dropdown and fill your sub-ohm tank from the bottle.
How do I open a shortfill bottle?

The cap is childproof: push it down firmly while twisting anticlockwise. Underneath is a narrow nozzle insert you pull straight out before adding shots, then press back in to refill a tank. Do not cut the nozzle.
Which shortfill VG/PG ratio is best for sub-ohm vaping?

70VG/30PG, which is what Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid uses. High VG gives dense vapour and is thick enough for coils under 1.0 ohm at 30W and above. A 50/50 blend is thinner and would flood most sub-ohm tanks.
What do the 3mg and 6mg options mean on Wow Exp 100ml E Liquid?

The bottle itself is always 0mg. The 3mg option includes two 10ml nicotine shots. Reaching 6mg in 100ml needs around four 18mg shots, giving about 5mg in 140ml, so check the shot count supplied with the 6mg option before mixing.
